[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Roleplay Rules[/color][/head]
Hullrot: Eclipsion is a roleplay-heavy server. A few situations come up often enough that they need to be spelled out, so everyone knows where the line sits.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Mutiny[/color][/head]
Turning on your own faction's command should never happen under normal circumstances. Special cases can override this, but only with prior [bold]admin approval[/bold].
[color=#8fc98a]Examples that may qualify:[/color]
- Killing your commanding officer after a reckless order that got allies killed. - Stirring up unrest inside your faction to overthrow its leadership and take control of an operation.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Round Removal (RR)[/color][/head]
Round removal means taking away a player's chance to be revived after they die.
[color=#e8b04b]Examples:[/color]
- Beheading a player or removing their brain so they cannot return to their body. - Ashing, spacing, or otherwise making a corpse impossible to recover.
Round removal is [color=#8fc98a]allowed[/color] during active combat between two or more factions.
Round removal is [bold][color=#d9776c]forbidden[/color][/bold] between two players of the [bold]same faction[/bold] under [bold]any circumstance[/bold].
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Hate Speech[/color][/head] [color=#6ab7d6]xenophobia, specism, slurs[/color]
This server has a dark atmosphere by design, so some antagonistic behavior is allowed [bold]in character[/bold]. That only ever means prejudice between the setting's own species and factions, such as a human looking down on a lizardperson. Real-world hate speech has no place here. Even in character you are expected to hold a higher standard and not use that freedom to ruin the game for someone [bold]on your own side[/bold].
[color=#8fc98a]Allowed[/color]
- Specism between characters of un-allied or enemy factions that builds into conflict and eventually combat. - Mild xenophobia between species, or an ongoing feud between two characters of the same faction that [bold]does not[/bold] lead to combat.
[color=#d9776c]Not allowed[/color]
- Two allied faction members fighting over an insult that was never escalated. - Attacking one or more allied faction members with or without any buildup. - Malding [bold]out of character[/bold] about dying and throwing slurs at another player.
